Schedule A Part I public-charity status flags

Source: R/affiliation.R
pf_schedule_a_status.Rd

The Part I checkbox is a status the filer declares about itself, which makes it stronger evidence than anything inferred from a name. Two boxes matter here:

Usage

pf_schedule_a_status(sched_a_p1)

Arguments

sched_a_p1

Path to SA-P01-T00-PUBLIC-CHARITY-STATUS-<year>.CSV, or the table itself.

Value

A data.table keyed by ein with logical govt_college, support_org, med_research, hospital, pub_support, plus hospital_name where line 4 named one.

Details

Line 5 (govt_college)

170(b)(1)(A)(iv) - "operated for the benefit of a college or university owned or operated by a governmental unit". This is the state university foundation, and it identifies the population where no affiliation disclosure can ever exist, because the parent is a government agency rather than a related nonprofit. 2,105 EINs nationally in 2022; of the MAYBE-tier arms that tick it, 92% could not be linked to a parent by Schedule A, Schedule R or the BMF.

Line 12 (support_org)

509(a)(3). The box whose accompanying table feeds pf_build_affiliation_links().

Line 4 (med_research) is included for completeness and is close to useless for this purpose: it covers medical research organizations operated in conjunction with a hospital, only 384 filers nationally, and none of the 927 arm pairs measured. Hospital arms tick line 12 or line 7 instead.
